description: Phase 3D. Exercises the conjure-family phantom-pool activation lifecycle and the no-IP-leak privacy invariant. Day 1 enables the experimental-families gate so conjure routes are selectable. Day 3 drives a soak-only conjure activation against a known phantom IP; diagnostics MUST surface `conjure_active_route` matching the route AND `conjure_phantom_in_use` MUST be a 16-hex-char hash (8-byte SHA-256 truncation) — the raw IP MUST NOT appear anywhere in diagnostics. Day 7 the rig drives a second activation against a different phantom IP; the hash MUST differ from day 3's. Day 14 clears the conjure activation; diagnostics MUST clear `conjure_active_route` AND `conjure_phantom_in_use` to empty strings. Day 20 exercises the locked invariant: conjure IS opportunistic — auto-promotion MAY promote a network whose only family is conjure (this is the dual of psiphon-blob-rotation's day 14). The legacy subscription-url block layers so the distribution-failure invariants continue to assert.
